title: Dream Team
one_paragraph_synopsis: In 'Dream Team,' the office experiences a mix of humorous interactions, conflicts, and revelations. Kevin struggles with phone transfers, Pam begins her new job and discusses stress management, and Michael presents a questionable business plan to Nana, introducing his exaggerated 'dream team.' Meanwhile, Michael announces he has started his own paper company, leading to office confrontations and a soccer game that results in injuries. The episode explores office dynamics, ambitions, and the characters' personal doubts and motivations, ending without clear resolutions on the outcomes of the new business ventures.
